issue.title: Raise sase-core-rs floor to 0.17.3 for bead_resolve_id
issue.description:
CI job published-core-minimum-smoke installs the exact minimum from pyproject.toml (sase-core-rs>=0.17.0,<0.18.0 -> 0.17.0) and runs tools/check_sase_core_rs_bindings, which requires every require_rust_binding name in src/ to exist in that wheel.

src/sase/core/bead_read_facade.py:32 calls require_rust_binding("bead_resolve_id"). That binding was added by sase-core commit 791e751 (feat(beads): resolve shorthand bead ids in core) and first ships in published sase-core-rs 0.17.3; `git grep bead_resolve_id v0.17.0 -- crates/sase_core_py/src/lib.rs` finds nothing. So the gate is red on master: a published-minimum install would AttributeError on any shorthand bead ID resolution.

The shorthand plan (sase/repos/plans/202607/bead_id_shorthand.md) never mentioned the dependency floor, which is how this slipped through.

Fix: bump pyproject.toml to sase-core-rs>=0.17.3,<0.18.0 and refresh uv.lock, then confirm with:
  python3 tools/smoke_sase_core_rs_telemetry --print-minimum pyproject.toml
  python3 tools/check_sase_core_rs_bindings   (in a venv with that published wheel)

This is independent of, and should land before, the pending 'multiple bead IDs in sase bead update' tale, which raises the floor again to whatever release carries the new bead_update_many binding.
